Yonhap NewsSamsung Electronics (005930.KS) and SK hynix (000660.KS), flush with cash from a semiconductor supercycle, are preparing to roll out shareholder returns on an unprecedented scale. Expectations among chip investors are rising after analysts projected that the two companies' combined pool for such returns could exceed 300 trillion won ($216 billion) a year.The two chipmakers are accelerating talks to revamp their shareholder-return policies following strong second-quarter results, industry sources said on the 16th.Samsung Electronics is maintaining its existing principle of returning 50% of free cash flow (FCF) to shareholders under a three-year plan running from 2024 to 2026. Its next plan is under internal review, aimed at setting a new balance between growth investment and shareholder returns.SK hynix has already announced a policy of using 50% of FCF from 2025 to 2027 as its funding pool for shareholder returns. It is also reviewing additional measures and plans to disclose details within the third quarter.Brokerages estimate the scale of returns could reach 200 trillion won at Samsung Electronics and 100 trillion won at SK hynix, for a combined 300 trillion won a year. Estimates vary by brokerage depending on the method of calculation.DS Investment & Securities said Samsung Electronics has room to return an additional 131.8 trillion won on top of its regular dividend of 29.4 trillion won. Daishin Securities said conditions are in place for SK hynix to secure a funding pool of up to 100 trillion won for shareholder returns.Mirae Asset Securities (006800.KS) estimated SK hynix's FCF this year at 180 trillion won. Setting aside 100 trillion won in safe assets would leave about 80 trillion won available, and using half of that for returns would amount to 40 trillion won, by its calculation.Weak share prices are another factor speeding up discussions of share buybacks and cancellations. SK hynix shares have fallen about 50% from their peak, and share cancellation is being floated as a way to offset concerns about dilution from an ADR issuance.In a recent response to a foreign news query, SK hynix said it believes it can meaningfully expand shareholder returns while maintaining investment and financial soundness on the strength of its cash-generating capacity.#SamsungElectronics#SKhynix#ShareholderReturns#Semiconductors#ChipStocks#ShareBuybackCompanies in this storySK hynix000660.KS · SemiconductorAI KEY Company Analysis →Samsung Electronics005930.KS · SemiconductorAI KEY Company Analysis →Original reporting by Nam Yun-jung for Seoul Economic Daily.AI-translated from Korean.
